terra.problem: The explanation says the violence starts with the injustice in their hearts. The verse mentions both but does not state that causal sequence.
The verse says the charmer is skillful, not that he plays his best song. It also does not explicitly say the rulers will not listen; that is stated without qualification.
The picture says the cobra refuses to hear, but it does not say it never sways.
A blunted arrow can still cause harm, so saying it cannot do its work is too absolute.
Blunted arrows can still cause damage. The explanation says they cannot.
Saying he'll be plain and not joke comments on how he tells the passage.
The verse says He will sweep them away before the pots feel the burning thorns. It does not say the pots will never get warm.
